name: APS Sector 1, beamline 1-ID (MPE)
distances: z_m = distance from the source along the beam (m); z_conf/z_src give provenance. Known so far (2026-11-11): the source (0) and the lens stacks in B/C/E and the default sample position in E, all from mpe_bluesky (~0.1 m resolution). Everything else is null (not guessed).
beam_direction: left to right on every operator panel (CS-Studio); hutch order downstream is SRC > A > B > C > E

hutches.SRC: Source: undulator and front end (not photographed)
hutches.A: First optics hutch: white-beam slits, A (front-end) shutter, HEM monochromator (not photographed; from code + earlier user notes)
hutches.B: Mono-beam hutch: ICs, CRLs, HRM, foil/attenuator, lens stacks, B fast shutter, Cork, Kohzu slit, B-TOM tomo stage
hutches.C: Beam-conditioning (ICs, slit, lens stacks L1-L6, attenuator, slit 2) then LabMotion sample stage, DBA, Tomo D1, stop, Varex D2, Lens7
hutches.E: Beam-conditioning (IC1+2, slit US, FS, Lens1-4, slit DS) then Aero SMS sample stage, Tomo D1, NF D2, D3, Hydra D4, VFF D5, Radiograph, SAXS D6

frame.x: horizontal. Looking downstream +x points LEFT (hardware-confirmed 2026-10-28 on samE: +x moves the pin image left). Drawn on the Aero_SMS/Aero_Trans panels as +X into the screen with +Z to the right and +Y up (right-handed).
frame.omega: samE.ry (1ide:m9): left-handed stage, +omega is clockwise seen from above (BLADE ROT_SIGN=+1)

snapshot.note: Operator-screen values at photo time. They are a snapshot of one state, NOT defaults or targets.
snapshot.panel_header_unlabelled_note: 'Delivered Beam 200.1 mA 10.012 mm 71.676 keV'; the mm value has no label on the panel, probably the undulator gap (unverified)
snapshot.fast_shutters: FS_B indicator dark, FS_E indicator bright green (open/closed colour convention not confirmed)

operator_screens.note: CS-Studio tabs visible on the beamline workstation (p12-p18). Panels photographed: B, C, E, All Slits, Aero_SMS, SAXS_D6, Aero_Trans. NOT photographed: 1-ID-Main (A hutch / mono / undulator).

workstation_viewers.note: Image windows open on the workstation (p11-p18), shown only as titles

coverage.C: panel photo (order + IC readings) + slit table + code; no hutch photos
coverage.E: panel + hutch photos (sample stack, lens stacks, tomo stage, monitor) + motor panels + code
